nothingIsOwedYet: Nothing is owed to you yet. The amount grows each day the schedule runs.
thePayingWalletCannotPayInFull: The paying wallet holds {held} of the {owed} owed to you, so it cannot pay in full yet.
thePayingWalletNeedsOneFundPool: No single fund pool can cover this payout. Ask the paying wallet owner to use Tidy funds. Tidy can merge pools only when their combined value contains at most {maxAssets} native assets. Otherwise an owner or the required co-signers must clean up the pools.
thePayoutAddressCouldNotBeRead: The payout address on this payment could not be read, so no payout can be built.
thisWalletSettledAPaymentRecently: This wallet settled a payment recently. It shares one 30-minute cooldown across every receiver action, so collecting has to wait.
